added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: blocking: The synthetic A and B axis gradients are 2.433e-4 and 2.638e-4, not rounding level, so done-when clause 1 and the manifest's all-record rebuild claim fail.

blocking: Capping out-of-wall rows at 200 omits 2,120 and 2,116 stationary points from the two synthetic per-record tables, contrary to the requirement to table every census point in the research page.

blocking: The disagreement summary compares only imas-efit with adapter A, skips records with absent A geometry and never compares adapter B; the receipt includes A-to-B saddle separations above 1 m that the required any-two-of-three summary cannot show.
blocking: Each machine-level caption only explains styles and omits each record's identity, both codes' axis and boundary psi, and both labels, which the source brief requires for every panel.

blocking: The five-column legend clips its final entries in the rendered AUG and synthetic panels, and the two-panel figures use a 7-inch canvas, so those delivered figures fail the figure visibility and size rules.
follow-on: The rebuild result is only stored, with no test or assertion that can fail on an excessive gradient, allowing the already failing synthetic rows to be reported as a completed gate.

item_verdicts.diff: Read dd5bdc5e9, da9daffa5, 69aeab270 and ec771eeaf commit by commit; they add the independent scipy analysis scripts, five SVGs and two pages, with no added test assertions or threshold refusal.
item_verdicts.done_when: The source brief's five clauses are only partly measured by out/analyse2.log and out/results.json; docs/research/efit-axis-adjudication.html:75-76 records two gradients above rounding level, while page.py:67 and page.py:149 omit required rows and pairwise comparisons.
item_verdicts.goal: The source brief requests adjudication plots and tables without a code verdict; docs/research/efit-axis-adjudication.html:49-86 supplies the plots and rebuild table, but omits required census rows and record-specific captions.
item_verdicts.manifest: The source manifest reports four commits, 26 analysed records and rendered panels, but its claim that every axis gradient is at rounding level conflicts with docs/research/efit-axis-adjudication.html:75-76, and it names no baseline_suite or after_suite.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The source brief grants scripts/prototypes/efit_axis_adjudication, the five-figure directory, the research page and the evidence fragment; git diff 1b25eedd7574fda2220c02fc33fffd39db9433bd..ec771eeaf6658b49073aa810ea581ebe3d7605a0 changes only those paths.

justifications.durability: scripts/prototypes/efit_axis_adjudication/analyse.py:227-231 writes rebuild values without asserting their bounds, so changing FastField to report a wrong gradient can still leave analyse.py:294 and the page generation green; the diff adds no test assertions, self-referential or otherwise.
justifications.evidence: docs/research/efit-axis-adjudication.html:75-76 displays gradient norms 0.000243 and 0.000264 despite the brief's rounding-level clause, and the source manifest records no paired suite arms.
justifications.fit: scripts/prototypes/efit_axis_adjudication/plot.py:104 uses nova.media.poloidal.draw_nulls and the source adds no forbidden symbol names, but plot.py:183 makes the two-panel figures half the required 14-inch width and their rendered legend clips.
justifications.goal_fidelity: scripts/prototypes/efit_axis_adjudication/page.py:67 drops 4,236 synthetic census rows from the requested per-record tables, and page.py:149 excludes adapter B from the disagreement summary.
justifications.reuse: A capability search found scripts/prototypes/read_robustness/census.py:26 for Bell-field roots, while scripts/prototypes/efit_axis_adjudication/field.py:17 and census.py:84 implement the independently required scipy record-spline census; plot.py:104 reuses nova.media.poloidal.draw_nulls.
justifications.scope_discipline: The base-to-head diff changes only the four path families granted by the source brief, including scripts/prototypes/efit_axis_adjudication/analyse.py and docs/research/efit-axis-adjudication.html.
